# Getting started with Customer Success

Define the basic customer success components

-   **[Create a customer success definition record](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/acct-lifecycle-events/account-lifecycle-create-ale-defn.html)**  
Define categories and subcategories for success play workflows.
-   **[Create a customer success choice record](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/acct-lifecycle-events/account-lifecycle-ale-choice.html)**  
Create a Customer Success Choice record to define a value for a dropdown or lookup field in the Customer Success Management application.

**Parent Topic:**[Configure customer success](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/acct-lifecycle-events/account-lifecycle-config-cust-success.html)
